problems.title: General compactness lemma does not exclude empty limits
problems.claim: Bounded centered Gaussian length and vanishing Gaussian shrinker defect force a nonempty line or radius-sqrt2 circle limit.
assumptions_checked: M_j unit circle centered(j,0),j>=3: connected smooth complete embedded.
problems.decisive_check: For every fixed compact ball, M_j is eventually absent. Only local measure limit is0, not a nonempty positive-multiplicity line/circle.
problems.core_dependency: Lemma invoked in rough-convergence Theorem3.3. The abstract compactness-to-nonempty-limit step needs an extra condition.
problems.impact_rationale: Minor because the actual ancient-flow application supplies a positive Gaussian mass lower bound and a uniform full entropy bound; the explicit obstruction can be excluded using available hypotheses. Main uniqueness theorem not refuted.
problems.repair_candidate: Add explicit local nonvanishing to lemma, or permit empty limit and exclude it in the application. Monotonicity gives F>=c>0; full entropy gives length(B_R)<=sqrt(4pi)e^(1/4)Lambda R and uniform Gaussian tails, retaining positive mass in a fixed ball.
problems.repair_boundary: Escape mechanism repaired in application; remaining compactness/classification steps not independently certified. No full revised lemma asserted.

issue_results.source_location: Lemma 3.1, physical p.13 / printed p.420; application Theorem 3.3, physical pp.14-16 / printed pp.421-423
issue_results.source_claim_verified: The displayed lemma quantifies over arbitrary connected smooth embedded planar curves with bounded centered F and vanishing weighted shrinker defect. No positive centered mass or fixed compact-intersection assumption is stated.
issue_results.assumptions_verified: The unit circles centered at (j,0), j>=3, are connected, complete, smooth, embedded and have no boundary. Length is 2pi; |kappa|=1 and j-1<=|x|<=j+1. Their F is <=sqrt(pi) exp(-(j-1)^2/4)<1. The shrinker defect is <=2pi(1+(j+1)/2)^2 exp(-(j-1)^2/4), tending to zero.
issue_results.decisive_evidence: Every fixed compact set is eventually disjoint from the circles. All local measure limits are zero, contradicting the nonempty positive-multiplicity line/circle conclusion. The native page image confirms this is not an extraction omission.
issue_results.counterevidence_and_application: The actual ancient-flow application has F(M_tau)>=F(M_tau*)=c>0 for tau<=tau* by monotonicity. Its uniform full entropy yields H1(M intersect B_R)<=sqrt(4pi)e^(1/4)Lambda R; annular summation gives a Gaussian tail tending to zero uniformly. A fixed ball therefore contains at least c/2 centered Gaussian mass. Completeness and full entropy alone do not block arbitrary translations; the positive centered mass anchor is essential.
issue_results.severity_reason: The false standalone lemma is established, but the exhibited counterexample is excluded for every admissible ancient-flow application by assumptions already present there. Minor reflects the demonstrated scope of the defect; it is not based on repair length, benchmark effects, or a whole-paper-collapse requirement.
issue_results.repair_verification: Allow an empty limit at the general compactness stage or impose nonvanishing; the mass/tail argument excludes the exhibited escape in the application. No certification of the remaining compactness/classification proof or the full uniqueness theorem.
